comment: Pilot-to-production gates for the fresh markdown advisor, status at the end of the pilot (week 18). 'blocking' gates must be done before wave 1 (60 stores).

gates.gate: Outcome KPI, baseline and pre-registered decision rules
Automated daily feed of sales, stock and waste per item-store (replaces the pilot extract)
Monitoring of suggestion quality and acceptance per store, with alert thresholds
Retraining and versioning procedure, with rollback to the previous model
Store procedure: who confirms markdowns, when, and how labels are printed
Support model: first line in stores, second line in IT, third line with the squad
Security review of the service and its integrations
AI register entry; AI Act triage (minimal); DPIA screening (staff ids only)
Training for store fresh teams (30 minutes) and AI literacy module
Works council informed; store staff feedback loop in place
Run cost per store per month known and inside the business case
Named product owner and budget for year 1 in the business unit's plan
